notes.title: Patch 1.0. Hard mode, new achievement, more cards, Level 20.
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Renan, game dev behind Dreamians: Card Battle. I have a few updates to share with you.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45047758/f3a453e75783c7493efac541b8732997c81e57c7.png"]

🔥 Hard Mode Unlocked!
Think you've mastered Dreamians? Think again! After beating the game in Normal Mode, you can now challenge yourself with Hard Mode, where enemies hit harder, have more Health, and reward you with bonus EXP! But beware:

Rest only heals 10 Life Points (instead of 20).

No story events—just pure, unfiltered combat!

📈 Level Cap Increased to 20!
Your Dreamian can now grow even stronger! Each new level unlocks special bonuses, so grind your way to the top!

⚠ Kalek Nerf:
Kalek’s starting max Health has been reduced from 70 to 50—better strategize those heals!

🏆 New Steam Achievement:
Prove your skills by finishing the game on Hard Mode and claim your bragging rights!

Update available now on Steam! 🚀



Thank you for you support. 



Renan

notes.title: Release: June 17, 2025
notes.notes:
White Vortex Games is thrilled to announce the official release of Dreamians: Card Battle on Steam for Windows PC on June 17, 2025. This strategic card game invites players to choose, evolve, and battle with unique creatures called Dreamians, blending deck-building mechanics with dynamic turn-based combat. With stunning visuals and deep gameplay, Dreamians: Card Battle promises an immersive experience for both casual and hardcore players.

Explore a vibrant world where strategy and creativity collide. Build your ultimate deck from over 100 cards, each featuring beautifully designed Dreamians with distinct abilities. Every match offers endless replayability and excitement.

Wishlist Dreamians: Card Battle now on Steam and stay updated via White Vortex Games’ official website. Prepare to duel, evolve, and save the world of dreams when the game launches next month!
